2607.07640.title: ALER-TI: Aligned Latent Embedding Retrieval for Time Series Imputation
2607.07640.paper_summary: Deep learning has significantly advanced time series imputation, yet most existing architectures primarily rely on localized temporal context within the corrupted input sequence. This reliance can be limiting in real-world scenarios, where time series often exhibit non-stationary dynamics, weak temporal correlations, and infrequent patterns that are difficult to reconstruct from nearby observations alone. In this paper, we propose ALER-TI, Aligned Latent Embedding Retrieval for Time Series Imputation, a retrieval-augmented framework that explicitly leverages historical patterns to supplement degraded local context for more reliable missing-value reconstruction. The core of ALER-TI is Latent Embedding Alignment (LEA), which mitigates the representation mismatch between corrupted queries and complete historical candidates. By applying post-hoc masking in the latent space, LEA aligns candidates with the query's missingness pattern while allowing historical embeddings to be pre-computed and cached for efficient retrieval. ALER-TI is model-agnostic and can be integrated with various imputation backbones through a lightweight adaptation module. Extensive experiments on six real-world datasets under different missing rates demonstrate that ALER-TI consistently improves strong baseline models and enhances robustness across diverse imputation settings.
2607.07640.paper_summary_zh: 深度學習在時間序列插補方面取得了顯著進展，但大多數現有架構主要依賴於受損輸入序列中的局部時間上下文。這種依賴在現實世界的場景中可能會受到限制，因為時間序列通常表現出非平穩動態、弱時間相關性以及難以僅從附近觀察中重建的稀有模式。在本文中，我們提出了 ALER-TI，即對時間序列插補的對齊潛在嵌入檢索，這是一個檢索增強框架，明確利用歷史模式來補充退化的局部上下文，以實現更可靠的缺失值重建。ALER-TI 的核心是潛在嵌入對齊 (LEA)，它減輕了受損查詢與完整歷史候選之間的表示不匹配。通過在潛在空間中應用事後遮罩，LEA 將候選者與查詢的缺失模式對齊，同時允許歷史嵌入進行預計算和緩存，以實現高效檢索。ALER-TI 是模型無關的，可以通過輕量級適配模塊與各種插補骨幹集成。在不同缺失率下對六個真實世界數據集的廣泛實驗表明，ALER-TI 一直在強基線模型上取得一致的改進，並在多樣的插補設置中增強了穩健性。
